en: Whatever the Rust executable must satisfy before it is merged is written down once, as an executable script, and CI runs the same list in the same order. A person runs just rust-check and sees exactly what the pull request will see: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings (a public item without documentation is a warning, so it is an error here), cargo test --no-fail-fast with the unit, integration and doc-example suites, cargo doc --no-deps with warnings denied, cargo bench --no-run, majordomus capabilities validate, majordomus generate --check, majordomus bench coverage --check, and cargo llvm-cov failing under the committed floor. CI runs one gate more, majordomus bench --profile ci --check --no-write, the benchmark check against the baseline committed for its own profile; a baseline is per platform and profile, so the script has none to check locally. Nothing in that list is advisory and nothing is skipped on a branch.
cs: Cokoli musí spustitelný soubor v Rustu splnit před mergem, je zapsáno jednou jako spustitelný skript a CI spouští stejný seznam ve stejném pořadí. Člověk spustí just rust-check a uvidí přesně to, co uvidí pull request: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings (veřejná položka bez dokumentace je varování, a tedy zde chyba), cargo test --no-fail-fast se sadami unit, integračních a testů příkladů v dokumentaci, cargo doc --no-deps s odmítnutými varováními, cargo bench --no-run, majordomus capabilities validate, majordomus generate --check, majordomus bench coverage --check a cargo llvm-cov selhávající pod commitovanou hranicí. CI spouští o jednu kontrolu více, majordomus bench --profile ci --check --no-write, kontrolu měření výkonu proti základní hodnotě commitované pro její vlastní profil; základní hodnota je pro platformu a profil, takže skript lokálně nemá co kontrolovat. Nic z toho seznamu není doporučení a nic se na branchi nepřeskakuje.

The executor merges only with a merge commit, because the derived-file driver resolves merges and a squash or a rebase would replay commits it never saw. The merge method is therefore <t43/> when the repository's settings allow a merge commit (<t44/>), and none otherwise; with none, every pull request the relation does not already decide is <t45/> (<t46/>, with <t47/> evidence) and the queue says why. The gate is asked after <t48/> because closing work that is already on master does not depend on the merge setting: a <t49/> pull request stays <t50/>, says <t51/> after its own reason, and <t52/> still closes it; so does a <t53/> one. The assessment's <t54/> lists each with whether it passed, and its <t55/> hold every failing gate's findings in the same order. The disposition is the first failing gate's, so a draft that also conflicts and fails its check is <t56/> and says all three. A failed required check is asked before freshness and a pending one after it: a head behind master needs a refresh, which runs its checks again, unless a check already failed. A gate that fails only because an earlier one did, such as freshness when the merge conflicts, fails without a reason of its own. The required checks are the base's branch protection and the rulesets that apply to it, together; if either cannot be read, nothing is ready. en: Several invariants are enforced well: no shadow operation inventory (projection-check, command-graph, mcp-tool-run, shell-inventory, mesh-check), generated drift (generate --check), skipped shell cases (test/run.sh --no-skips). Others are not. The full scheduled CI plan, the only one that selects every gate, has not produced a green verdict in its last <n1/> runs while push runs on master stay green, and nothing alarms; rule project.never-reported-is-not-green is review-only. rule-proof calls a rule satisfied when its proof is named and present: of <n2/> rules, <n3/> are 'not run'. No guard keeps a credential out of HTTP responses, MCP results, logs or mesh frames (apps/majordomus-cli/src/generate.rs:<n4/> guards generated documents only), and redaction::public_text has no production caller (apps/majordomus-cli/src/redaction.rs:<n5/>). Nothing starts a shared server from an installed release in a foreign repository, and the release smoke swallows the launcher's failure (.github/workflows/release.yml:<n6/>). Measured in the runtime baseline audit of 2026-10-09 at master 1fb8d6be44 (plan/RUNTIME_BASELINE.md).
cs: Několik invariantů je vynucováno dobře: žádný stínový inventář operací (projection-check, command-graph, mcp-tool-run, shell-inventory, mesh-check), generovaný drift (generate --check), přeskočené shellové případy (test/run.sh --no-skips). Jiné ne. Úplný plánovaný plán CI, jediný, který vybírá každou kontrolu, nevytvořil zelený verdikt ve svých posledních <n1/> bězích, zatímco běhy po pushi na masteru zůstávají zelené, a nic nealarmuje; pravidlo project.never-reported-is-not-green je pouze review. rule-proof nazývá pravidlo splněným, když je jeho důkaz pojmenován a přítomen: ze <n2/> pravidel je <n3/> 'not run'. Žádná ochrana nebrání přihlašovacímu údaji dostat se do odpovědí HTTP, výsledků MCP, logů nebo rámců meshe (apps/majordomus-cli/src/generate.rs:<n4/> hlídá jen generované dokumenty) a redaction::public_text nemá produkčního volajícího (apps/majordomus-cli/src/redaction.rs:<n5/>). Nic nespouští sdílený server z nainstalovaného release v cizím repozitáři a smoke test releasu selhání launcheru pohlcuje (.github/workflows/release.yml:<n6/>).
